summary: The changes successfully implement the navigation update, heading size increase, added service item, and taller footer. However, box 3 shows an unintended color change on the Savings Accounts card.

regressions.explanation: The Savings Accounts card background color was unintentionally changed from soft green to a reddish pink hue, which contradicts the design intent.
regressions.violated_rule: The Savings Accounts card was not changed at all according to design intent.
